estimates.assumptions: 4 meaty veal shanks estimated at ~450g each (total 1.8kg bone-in); values for raw veal shank meat + marrow; ~45g protein and ~22.5g fat per 450g shank.
½ cup (65g) all-purpose flour; standard values for white flour.
2 tablespoons (28g) olive oil; all oil is used in browning and retained in the final dish.
3 tablespoons (42g) butter; total used across steps and retained in sauce.
1 medium onion (~110g) chopped; standard raw onion values.
1 medium carrot (~60g) chopped; standard raw carrot values.
1 celery stalk (~40g) chopped; standard raw celery values.
1 medium fennel bulb (~150g) chopped; standard raw fennel values.
3 garlic cloves (~9g); standard raw garlic values.
2 strips orange zest (~6g); negligible contribution from peel only.
1½ teaspoons dried marjoram (~1.5g); negligible contribution from dried herb.
1 bay leaf (~0.5g); negligible contribution from whole leaf.
1 cup (240ml) dry white wine; standard values, alcohol mostly evaporates but base calories retained.
½ cup (120ml) chicken stock; typical low-sodium broth values.
1 cup (~240g) chopped canned tomatoes with juice; standard values.
2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley (~8g); standard raw parsley values.
1 teaspoon minced garlic (~3g); standard raw garlic values for gremolata.
1 teaspoon grated lemon zest (~2g); negligible contribution from peel only.
